description: Defines interfaces for scheduling, rescheduling, checking, canceling, and executing delayed background tasks, including time-based and delay-based scheduling, with support for task handles and debug finalization.

methods.name: scheduleDelayTask
methods.description: Creates a one-time delayed task that executes a callback after a specified delay.

methods.name: scheduleTimeOfDayTask
methods.description: Schedules a task to run at a specific time of day.

methods.name: rescheduleDelayTask
methods.description: Reschedules an existing delayed task to a new delay.

methods.name: isDelayTaskWaiting
methods.description: Checks if a delayed task is still waiting to execute.

methods.name: cancelDelayTask
methods.description: Cancels a delayed task if it is still waiting and returns its argument.

methods.name: exceuteDelayTask
methods.description: Immediately executes a delayed task if it is pending.

methods.name: finalizeAllDelayTasks
methods.description: Forces completion of all delayed tasks (debug mode).
